name: FISMA / NIST RMF
version: 2014 RMF with current NIST SP 800-53 context
description: Federal information-system risk management obligations covering categorization, control selection, implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring.

requirements.title: Categorize the information system
requirements.description: Document the system, information types, impact levels, and authorization boundary.
requirements.source_reference: FIPS 199 and NIST SP 800-60 / RMF Prepare-Categorize

requirements.title: Select and tailor controls
requirements.description: Select, tailor, and document the applicable controls and enhancements for the system baseline.

requirements.title: Implement controls
requirements.description: Implement and document the controls within the approved system boundary.

requirements.title: Assess control effectiveness
requirements.description: Assess controls using defined procedures and retain the assessment results and evidence.

requirements.title: Authorize the system
requirements.description: Maintain a current authorization decision based on documented risk and assessment results.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 and RMF Authorize

requirements.title: Continuous monitoring
requirements.description: Monitor control effectiveness, changes, vulnerabilities, incidents, and risk on an established cadence.
requirements.source_reference: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 and RMF Monitor

requirements.title: Track remediation and risk
requirements.description: Track weaknesses, corrective actions, milestones, owners, and residual risk through closure or acceptance.
requirements.source_reference: FISMA continuous monitoring and agency POA&M policy

requirements.title: Report security status
requirements.description: Provide current security status and incident or risk reporting required by agency policy and FISMA oversight.
requirements.source_reference: FISMA and applicable agency reporting policy
